headline.preserves: rasterised at 1920x1080, held for the slide's clip

bars.drops: the bars do not grow in

diagram.drops: per-edge build; paths do not animate

note.preserves: full: the narration cue, as a subtitle track (from present.sequence)

deck.sections: degrades: chapter markers in the container
deck.transition: full: fade and push rendered between clips; magic renders as fade

notes: Encodes one frame per slide (held for its clip) plus the subtitle track into a video. The honest gap: nothing in the arsenal produces media.video_frame from a scene.slide today; that rasteriser (a headless print of present.slides-html) is the missing module, and this manifest names it as the `frames` input rather than pretending to own it. The bundled FFmpeg's build configuration is unverified, so its licence is not asserted.
